method: greedy hill climbing with paired trials and a seed-variance noise floor

accepted.title: Muon optimizer for hidden weights
accepted.claim: Orthogonalized momentum updates roughly double token efficiency versus AdamW.
accepted.expect: clearly lower val loss at the same step budget.

accepted.title: Disable dropout
accepted.claim: In the data-rich / few-epoch regime, dropout costs capacity without preventing overfit.
accepted.expect: lower val loss when the train/val gap is already small.

accepted.title: Rotary position embeddings
accepted.claim: Relative position injected by rotating q/k beats a learned absolute table.
accepted.expect: lower val loss and no learned position parameters.

accepted.title: Query-key normalization
accepted.claim: Normalizing q,k bounds attention logits and prevents attention entropy collapse.
accepted.expect: lower max attention logit; enables a higher stable learning rate.

accepted.title: Raise peak learning rate 2x
accepted.claim: Small models tolerate much higher LR than large-model defaults suggest; tune on the proxy.
accepted.expect: lower val loss if stable, divergence if not - this is a genuine risk trial.

rejected.title: Tied input/output embeddings
rejected.claim: Sharing the embedding matrix with the output head cuts parameters and helps perplexity.
rejected.expect: fewer parameters; equal or better val loss.

rejected.title: SwiGLU feed-forward
rejected.claim: Gated FFNs beat GELU FFNs at matched parameter count.
rejected.expect: lower val loss at ~equal parameters (d_ff shrinks to 8/3*d).

rejected.title: Warmup-Stable-Decay schedule
rejected.claim: A constant-LR body with a short final decay matches or beats cosine and is budget-agnostic.
rejected.expect: equal or lower final val loss; loss plateau then sharp end-of-run drop.

rejected.title: 1/sqrt(2L) residual-projection init
rejected.claim: Down-scaling residual-branch output init keeps activation variance constant with depth.
rejected.expect: smaller early grad-norm spike; faster early loss drop.

rejected.title: Weight decay only on matrices
rejected.claim: Decoupled decay applied to 2-D weights (not norms/biases/embeddings) regularizes correctly.
rejected.expect: smaller train/val gap at equal train loss.

rejected.title: RMSNorm instead of LayerNorm
rejected.claim: Removing mean-centering matches LayerNorm quality at lower cost.
rejected.expect: val loss within noise; measurably higher tokens/s.

rejected.title: Softmax z-loss
rejected.claim: Penalizing log-Z^2 keeps the softmax normalizer near 1 and stops logit drift.
rejected.expect: bounded logit norm; equal or slightly better loss, better calibration.

rejected.title: tanh logit soft-capping
rejected.claim: Soft-capping final logits bounds them smoothly without hard clipping.
rejected.expect: lower max logit; loss within noise.

rejected.title: Raise RoPE base to 50k
rejected.claim: A larger rotary base lowers frequency aliasing and eases later context extension.
rejected.expect: neutral at 512 ctx - included to demonstrate a true null result.

rejected.title: Grouped-query attention
rejected.claim: Sharing K/V across head groups keeps quality while shrinking the KV cache.
rejected.expect: val loss within noise; 3x smaller KV cache and faster decode.

rejected.title: Label smoothing 0.05
rejected.claim: Smoothing targets curbs overconfidence and improves calibration.
rejected.expect: better ECE, slightly worse raw CE - a deliberate metric trade-off.

rejected.title: Longer LR warmup
rejected.claim: Warmup compensates for high adaptive-LR variance in the first few hundred steps.
rejected.expect: lower early grad-norm; more stable start.
